note: Spoken text for every battlefield narrator. The Defender clips in public/audio/narrator/defender/ were made outside this catalogue with TTSMaker voice 2403 (Jennifer, UK English female) and have no recorded script, so they are authoritative assets and this tool never rewrites them. Only the Eastern narrator is synthesised here.

defender.label: Defender tactical AI
defender.notes: Female, coalition tactical AI. Shipped recordings are TTSMaker voice 2403 (Jennifer, UK English female), used outside this catalogue and treated as authoritative; they are never regenerated. af_bella is the closest Kokoro-82M female by median pitch and brightness (207 Hz / centroid 3034 against 195 Hz / 3695 measured across the shipped clips). It exists only so a future Defender line could be generated in a similar register, under the matching process in docs/NARRATORS.md; no generated line may replace an existing one.

eastern.label: Eastern command AI
eastern.assetVoice: ElevenLabs v4 recording (one take, split by tools/narrator-voice/split.py)
eastern.notes: Male, command-network AI. The shipped clips are a single ElevenLabs v4 take, split into cues by tools/narrator-voice/split.py and levelled to the Defender median; they are authoritative and the generator never overwrites them. One short sentence per cue: the Defender AI reports in two clauses, this one states the fact and stops. am_adam is only the Kokoro fallback for a future line, picked by ear from docs/narrator-voice-candidates.html as a composed default with no regional colour or theatrics; it is also a unit bark voice, so narrator clips are mixed as a clean command channel rather than field radio.
